svg.title: Interpolating inundation depth from a series of SLR GeoTIFFs
svg.desc: A hazard CSV lists one GeoTIFF per sea-level rise value. The exposure is sampled on each GeoTIFF, giving a depth for each SLR. These points form a curve, and apply_continuous interpolates the depth for any SLR, such as 0.15m giving 0.65m.
